subject: Kickstart: compact MAP template + draft closure timeline
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Lane <emma.lane@clearwave.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Kickstart: compact MAP template + draft closure timeline

Hi Emma —

Great to meet you yesterday. As promised, I attached a compact mutual action plan (MAP) template to make the first 30–60 days concrete and to accelerate approval/PO steps. Quick ask: could you loop in procurement (procurement@clearwave.health) and your technical lead so we can confirm the week-by-week checkpoints below?

High level (proposal):
- Week 0: kickoff + AD (security) questionnaire + access provisioning
- Week 1–2: integration spike (sample dataset, latency checks)
- Week 3: feature validation with 2 pilot workflows
- Week 4: acceptance run + SLA review + procurement signoff

I also added a compact slide deck that maps these checkpoints to owners and acceptance criteria — you can edit the Google Slides/Doc I shared. Links and stubs attached.

Attachments (stubs):
- CW-MAP-compact-template-v1.gdoc (Google Doc)
- CW-MAP-week-by-week-slides-v1.gslides (Google Slides)
- acceptance-criteria-checklist.xlsx

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) We add your tech lead and procurement on the Doc for week-by-week owners.
2) Can we tentatively target the integration spike for the week of June 2 (we have a 2-hr reserved slot for onboarding)?
3) I’ll capture risks/mitigations in the MAP and drop them into the acceptance checklist.

Thanks — I’ll keep this lightweight.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0193
From: Emma Lane <emma.lane@clearwave.health>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, procurement@clearwave.health
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickstart: compact MAP template + draft closure timeline

Sean —

Thanks for the note and the template. I shared the Doc with our procurement team and forwarded to Ajay (tech lead) — Ajay is now copied (he'll be on a plane for most of Friday but can join early next week).

Quick responses:
- Week of June 2 works for an integration spike; prefer the morning Pacific slot.
- Procurement asked for a short summary of expected data flows and retention policy so they can start the PO paperwork; can you add a one-paragraph data-handling note in the Doc?
- We like the acceptance checklist format — can your team populate the sample acceptance tests for the two pilot workflows?

I’ll coordinate internally and push procurement to provide a lead contact. Looking forward to seeing the draft slides.

Best,
Emma Lane
Product Ops Manager | ClearWave Health
emma.lane@clearwave.health | (617) 555-4401
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Lane <emma.lane@clearwave.health>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 May 2025 08:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickstart: compact MAP template + draft closure timeline

Emma / Sean —

Thanks for looping procurement and Ajay in. I took a pass on the MAP doc and added a short data-handling blurb under "Security & Data" (link in the Drive). I also sketched a tighter 4-week closure timeline in the slides that maps owners and required artifacts per week. Main notes:

- Data handling: minimal retention during pilot (14 days), scoped access for dev/test accounts only, logs stored encrypted; added KMS pointer and contact for our security team.
- Integration spike: we need a sample payload and one small dataset (preferably synthetic) from Ajay to run the latency/throughput checks; if Ajay can attach that to the Doc we’ll schedule the spike.
- Acceptance tests: Jasmine added two sample test cases (end-to-end latency under 300ms p95 for conversational workflow; accuracy threshold for reranking at 85% on labelled set).

Attachments I pushed into Drive (stubs):
- CW-MAP-week-by-week-slides-v1.gslides (updated)
- acceptance-criteria-checklist.xlsx (populated with sample tests)

If that looks good, Sean — can you send a 30-min scheduling poll for week of June 2 (mornings PT) and include Ajay/procurement? I’ll book a technical readout slot for our engineering lead to join.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Lane <emma.lane@clearwave.health>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 May 2025 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickstart: compact MAP template + draft closure timeline

Emma / team —

Perfect — thanks for the quick edits, Marissa, and thanks Emma for looping procurement. I created a 30-minute poll for June 3–5 mornings PT and included the Drive links in the poll description. Link to the living MAP: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C4dCW-MAP-compact-template

Next actions (finalizing now):
1) Emma / Ajay: drop the sample dataset + confirm the day/time from the poll (if Ajay is mobile Friday, June 4 morning PT works for us).
2) Marissa / Jasmine: finalize the acceptance-tests sheet by EOD Monday (I see Jasmine already added two cases).
3) Procurement: Sean to provide a 1-paragraph data-handling note (Marissa added a more technical blurb; I'll paste a short summary into the Doc for procurement to reference).

I’ll also add a short line to the MAP about fallback routing and canary policy (operationally important for pilot).

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0193
